questions.markdown:
An AC sinusoidal voltage of peak value $20\text{ V}$ and frequency $50\text{ Hz}$ is applied to half wave rectifier.

The cut-in voltage of the diode is $0.5\text{ V}$. If the load resistance is $700\Omega$ and diode forward resistance is $7\Omega$, determine the following.

i) Average output voltage  
ii) Rms output voltage  
iii) Efficiency  
iv) Ripple factor

Design a capacitor filter to reduce the ripple factor to half.

A Germanium diode has a saturation current of $4\text{ pA}$ at $27^{0}\text{C}$.

Determine:

(i) Diode bias voltage when diode current is $4\text{ mA}$.  
(ii) Diode current when the temperature changes to $310\text{ K}$, for the same bias voltage.  
(iii) Also determine the dynamic resistance of the diode for both the cases (i) and (ii).

Design a Zener voltage regulator for output voltage of $20\text{ V}$, input voltage of $30\text{ V}$, $R_L(\min)=200\Omega$, and $R_L(\max)=\infty$.

Given the power rating of Zener diode are $P_{Z\min}=60\text{ mW}$ and $P_{Z\max}=60\text{ W}$.

Determine the range of series resistance $R_s$.
